schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.objective: Direct income support to landholding farmers to supplement financial needs for procuring agricultural inputs and ensuring proper crop health.
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000/year in 3 instalments of ₹2,000 each via Direct Benefit Transfer to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmers except taxpayers, govt employees, professional practitioners, and pensioners.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.objective: Provide comprehensive insurance coverage against crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
schemes.benefit: Premium: Kharif 2%, Rabi 1.5%, Horticulture 5%. Balance subsidized by Central and State governments.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers (loanee and non-loanee) at Block/Gram Panchayat level.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.objective: Provide old age social security and pension support to small and marginal farmers.
schemes.benefit: ₹3,000 monthly pension after 60 years. Contributory scheme with equal govt contribution.
schemes.eligibility: Small and marginal farmers (up to 2 hectares) aged 18-40 years at entry.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.objective: Provide adequate and timely credit support to farmers for agricultural operations.
schemes.benefit: 7% interest rate with 2% interest subvention (effective 4%). Additional 3% incentive for timely repayment.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.objective: Assess soil health and provide crop-wise recommendations to improve soil fertility and productivity.
schemes.benefit: Free soil testing. Printed Soil Health Card with crop-wise nutrient recommendations.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PM-KSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti and Ministry of Agriculture
schemes.objective: Expand cultivable area under irrigation and improve water use efficiency.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy on drip/sprinkler irrigation. 55% subsidy on equipment with government support.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers with priority to small and marginal farmers.

schemes.name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
schemes.objective: Create unified national agricultural market for transparent online trading.
schemes.benefit: Better price discovery. Reduced transaction costs. Direct access to multiple buyers.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.objective: Accelerate agricultural mechanization especially for small and marginal farmers.
schemes.benefit: 40-50% subsidy on farm machinery. Higher for SC/ST and women farmers.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.objective: Provide medium to long-term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure.
schemes.benefit: Loans with 3% interest subvention. Credit guarantee coverage up to ₹2 crore.

schemes.name: Formation & Promotion of 10,000 FPOs
schemes.objective: Form and promote 10,000 FPOs to empower farmers through collectivization.
schemes.benefit: Equity grant up to ₹15 lakh per FPO. Credit guarantee up to ₹2 crore.
schemes.eligibility: Groups of small and marginal farmers forming new FPOs.

schemes.name: Digital Agriculture Mission (DAM)
schemes.objective: Use Digital Public Infrastructure and technology to improve farmers' lives.
schemes.benefit: Agri Stack integration. Krishi Decision Support System. AI/ML-based tools.

schemes.name: Crop Science for Food and Nutritional Security
schemes.objective: Prepare farmers for climate resilience and ensure food security by 2047.
schemes.benefit: Development of climate-resilient crop varieties. Enhanced nutritional quality.

schemes.name: Sustainable Livestock Health and Production
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.objective: Increase farmers' income from livestock through improved animal health management.
schemes.benefit: Disease surveillance, vaccination programs, veterinary education support.

schemes.name: Sustainable Development of Horticulture
schemes.objective: Increase farmers' income through sustainable horticulture development.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy for plantation, productivity improvement, post-harvest management.

schemes.name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM)
schemes.objective: Promote scientific beekeeping for increased crop productivity through pollination.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy on bee boxes, processing units, training and capacity building.

schemes.name: Namo Drone Didi
schemes.objective: Empower women through drone technology for agricultural operations.
schemes.benefit: 80% subsidy on drone cost (max ₹8 lakh). Expected income ₹1 lakh+ per year per SHG.

schemes.name: National Mission on Edible Oil - Oil Palm (NMEO-OP)
schemes.objective: Increase domestic edible oil production and reduce import dependency.
schemes.benefit: ₹31,500 per hectare for planting material. Assured buyback at remunerative prices.

schemes.name: Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS)
schemes.objective: Provide short-term agricultural credit at reduced interest rates.
schemes.benefit: 7% interest rate with 3% subvention for prompt repayment (effective 4%).
schemes.eligibility: All farmers availing short-term crop loans from banks.

schemes.name: Rainfed Area Development Programme (RADP)
schemes.objective: Sustainable development of rainfed agriculture through integrated farming system.
schemes.benefit: Support for water conservation, soil health, crop diversification, livestock.

schemes.name: National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
schemes.objective: Make agriculture productive, sustainable, and climate resilient.
schemes.benefit: Support for soil health, rainfed areas, climate change adaptation, water management.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers with focus on small and marginal farmers.

schemes.name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
schemes.objective: Increase production of rice, wheat, pulses, and coarse cereals.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy on improved seeds, fertilizers, equipment, training.

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
schemes.objective: Holistic growth of horticulture sector through area and productivity expansion.
schemes.benefit: Credit-linked subsidy. 40-50% subsidy for production. 40-60% for post-harvest.
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, SHGs, NGOs, govt agencies.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.objective: Bring about Blue Revolution through sustainable fisheries development.
schemes.benefit: Up to 60% subsidy for general category. Up to 75% for SC/ST/Women.
schemes.eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, FPOs, entrepreneurs, SHGs, cooperatives.

schemes.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) Strengthening
schemes.objective: Technology assessment and demonstration for farmer application.
schemes.benefit: Free advisory services, subsidized soil testing, training programs.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers, rural youth, extension workers.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR)
schemes.objective: Incentivize states to increase public investment in agriculture.
schemes.benefit: 100% grant to states. Additional allocation based on performance.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.objective: Promote organic farming through cluster approach and PGS certification.
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs and certification.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming in clusters.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
schemes.objective: Ensure remunerative prices to farmers for their produce.
schemes.benefit: Price Support Scheme, Price Deficiency Payment, or Private Procurement.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers producing covered crops (oilseeds, pulses, copra).

schemes.name: National Horticulture Board (NHB) Schemes
schemes.objective: Develop horticulture infrastructure and support.
schemes.benefit: Credit-linked subsidy. 35-50% subsidy on cold storage, processing units.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
schemes.objective: Provide financial and water security to farmers through solar power.
schemes.benefit: 60% subsidy through Centre + State. 30% bank loan. Farmer pays 10%.

schemes.name: Gramin Bhandaran Yojana (GBY)
schemes.objective: Create scientific storage capacity in rural areas.
schemes.benefit: 15-33% subsidy on warehouse construction. Max ₹1.50-3.33 crore.
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers, cooperatives, FPOs, SHGs, govt agencies.

schemes.name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.objective: Sustainable livestock sector development with focus on feed, breed, and extension.
schemes.benefit: 60:40 or 90:10 financial pattern. Up to 40-50% subsidy on components.

schemes.name: Blue Revolution - Integrated Development of Fisheries
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.objective: Enhance fish production and productivity through sustainable development.
schemes.benefit: 25-50% subsidy on various interventions. Higher for SC/ST/Women.
schemes.eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, SHGs, FPOs, cooperatives.

schemes.name: National Programme for Dairy Development (NPDD)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.objective: Create/strengthen infrastructure for quality milk procurement and processing.
schemes.benefit: Mix of grants and loans. Varies by component.
schemes.eligibility: Dairy cooperatives, Milk Producer Companies, FPOs, Milk Unions.

schemes.name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.objective: Incentivize private investment in dairy and meat processing infrastructure.
schemes.benefit: 3% interest subvention for 8 years. 2-year moratorium on principal.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.objective: Development and conservation of indigenous bovine breeds.
schemes.benefit: Establishment of Gokul Grams. Subsidy for farmers maintaining indigenous breeds.
schemes.eligibility: Govt farms, cooperatives, FPOs, private sector, NGOs.

schemes.name: Interest Subvention Scheme for Animal Husbandry
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.objective: Provide affordable credit to farmers for animal husbandry activities.
schemes.benefit: 3% interest subvention on loans for dairy, poultry, goat, pig, fishery.

schemes.name: Urea Subsidy Scheme
schemes.objective: Provide urea fertilizer to farmers at affordable prices.
schemes.benefit: Government subsidizes difference between production cost and Maximum Retail Price (MRP).

schemes.name: Strengthening Agricultural Education, Management & Social Sciences
schemes.objective: Prepare agriculture students for current and future challenges.
schemes.benefit: Curriculum modernization, faculty development, research grants.

schemes.name: APEDA Export Promotion Scheme
schemes.objective: Increase exports of agricultural and processed food products.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance, logistical support, packaging, market research help.
schemes.eligibility: Registered agricultural exporters, FPOs, farmer cooperatives.

schemes.name: Central Sector Scheme on Strengthening Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs)
schemes.objective: Strengthen KVKs as frontline extension centers for technology dissemination.
schemes.benefit: Infrastructure development, human resources, operational expenses.

schemes.name: Rythu Bandhu (Telangana)
schemes.objective: Provide investment support to farmers for agricultural inputs.
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000/acre per season. Total ₹10,000/acre/year (Kharif + Rabi).

schemes.name: Rythu Bheema (Telangana)
schemes.objective: Provide life insurance coverage to farmers.
schemes.benefit: ₹5 lakh life insurance coverage. Free of cost (state pays premium).
schemes.eligibility: All farmers aged 18-59 years in Telangana.

schemes.name: KALIA (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation) - Odisha
schemes.objective: Provide multi-dimensional financial and social security to farming families.
schemes.benefit: ₹25,000/year for cultivators. ₹12,500/year for landless. ₹2 lakh life insurance.
schemes.eligibility: Small, marginal, landless agricultural households in Odisha.

schemes.name: YSR Rythu Bharosa (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.objective: Provide investment support to all farmers.
schemes.benefit: ₹13,500/year. Includes tenant farmers. Higher than PM-KISAN when combined (₹19,500).
schemes.eligibility: All farmers (landowners and tenant farmers) in Andhra Pradesh.

schemes.name: YSR Sunna Vaddi (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.objective: Provide interest-free crop loans.
schemes.benefit: Interest-free crop loans up to ₹1.5 lakh. Additional ₹50,000 for allied activities.

schemes.name: Crop Diversification Programme (Punjab)
schemes.objective: Reduce area under paddy and promote crop diversification.
schemes.benefit: ₹4,000-₹7,000/acre incentive for shifting from paddy to alternatives.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers in Punjab willing to diversify from paddy.

schemes.name: Pani Bachao, Paisa Kamao (Punjab)
schemes.objective: Conserve groundwater through efficient irrigation.
schemes.benefit: ₹10,000/acre incentive. Additional subsidy on irrigation equipment.

schemes.name: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana (Haryana)
schemes.objective: Protect farmers from distress sale of horticulture crops.
schemes.benefit: Direct payment of difference between MSP/FRP and actual market price.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers selling in notified mandis in Haryana.

schemes.name: Meri Fasal Mera Byora (Haryana)
schemes.objective: Create comprehensive farmers and crop database for better scheme implementation.
schemes.benefit: One-time registration for all schemes. Automatic eligibility. Quick disbursement.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers seeking govt benefits in Haryana.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
schemes.objective: Provide supplementary income support to farmers.
schemes.benefit: ₹4,000/year in two instalments. Supplementary to PM-KISAN (total ₹10,000/year).
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmers in Madhya Pradesh.

schemes.name: Balram Tal Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
schemes.objective: Rainwater harvesting and conservation for irrigation.
schemes.benefit: 40% subsidy on farm ponds. 50% for SC/ST farmers.

schemes.name: Krishak Bandhu (West Bengal)
schemes.objective: Provide income support and life insurance to farmers.
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000/acre/year (max ₹10,000/year). ₹2 lakh death benefit.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers in West Bengal (landowners and sharecroppers).

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana (Jharkhand)
schemes.objective: Provide income support to small and marginal farmers.
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000/acre/year. Max ₹25,000/year for up to 5 acres.
schemes.eligibility: Small and marginal farmers in Jharkhand.

schemes.name: Raitha Suraksha (Karnataka)
schemes.objective: Enhance crop insurance coverage.
schemes.benefit: State govt bears farmer's premium share. Zero premium for farmers.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojana (Rajasthan)
schemes.objective: Reduce agricultural electricity costs.
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹1,000/month subsidy (max ₹12,000/year) on agricultural bills.

schemes.name: Rajasthan Krishi Upaj Rinn Yojana
schemes.objective: Provide interest-free crop loans.
schemes.benefit: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh at 0% interest. State pays interest.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers in Rajasthan through cooperative banks.

schemes.name: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
schemes.objective: Provide input cost support to farmers.
schemes.benefit: ₹9,000-₹10,000/acre depending on crop. Direct cash transfer.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers in Chhattisgarh growing covered crops.

schemes.name: Godhan Nyay Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
schemes.objective: Procure cattle dung for vermi-compost and organic manure production.
schemes.benefit: ₹2/kg for cattle dung. Additional income for farmers and cattle owners.
schemes.eligibility: All cattle owners including landless farmers and women SHGs.

schemes.name: Interest-Free Loan for Farmers (Kerala)
schemes.objective: Provide interest-free crop loans.
schemes.benefit: Crop loans up to ₹2 lakh at 0% interest for agricultural and allied activities.

schemes.name: Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.objective: Provide enhanced crop insurance protection.
schemes.benefit: Enhanced crop insurance coverage. ₹2 lakh personal accident cover.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana (Gujarat)
schemes.objective: Provide relief for crop losses due to natural calamities.
schemes.benefit: ₹20,000-₹25,000/hectare based on crop loss percentage (max 4 hectares).

schemes.name: Soil Health Card - Gujarat Enhancement
schemes.objective: Provide advanced soil testing with mobile labs.
schemes.benefit: Free advanced soil testing. 20+ parameters tested. Quick results (7 days).

schemes.name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Shetkari Karjmukti Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.objective: Provide loan waiver to farmers.
schemes.benefit: Loan waiver up to ₹2 lakh per farmer for cooperative crop loans.
schemes.eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with outstanding crop loans.

schemes.name: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan (Maharashtra)
schemes.objective: Make Maharashtra drought-free through water conservation.
schemes.benefit: Government funding for village water conservation projects.

schemes.name: MahaAgri-AI Policy (Maharashtra)
schemes.objective: Transform Maharashtra agriculture through AI, drones, and precision tech.
schemes.benefit: VISTAAR-AI platform, Agro Data Exchange, blockchain traceability, AI sandbox.

schemes.name: Mahavedh - WINDS (Maharashtra)
schemes.objective: Provide accurate localized weather information to farmers.
schemes.benefit: Hyperlocal weather forecasts. Weather-based crop advisories. Extreme weather alerts.

schemes.name: Kisan Kalyan Mission (Uttar Pradesh)
schemes.objective: Comprehensive agricultural development and farmer support.
schemes.benefit: Soil health improvement, seed distribution, equipment subsidy, marketing support.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Khet Suraksha Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
schemes.objective: Prevent farm fires and stubble burning.
schemes.benefit: 50-80% subsidy on stubble management equipment (happy seeder, balers, etc).
schemes.eligibility: Farmers in UP, especially in fire-prone districts.

schemes.name: Diesel Anudan Yojana (Bihar)
schemes.objective: Reduce irrigation costs through diesel subsidy.
schemes.benefit: ₹50/liter subsidy on diesel for agricultural use. Max 1200 liters/year.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers in Bihar with diesel pump sets.

schemes.name: Krishi Yantra Anudan Yojana (Bihar)
schemes.objective: Promote agricultural mechanization.
schemes.benefit: 40-80% subsidy on agricultural equipment. Higher for SC/ST farmers.

schemes.name: Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
schemes.objective: Empower women with financial support enabling agricultural investments.
schemes.benefit: ₹1,250/month (₹15,000/year). Enables agri-investments and entrepreneurship.
schemes.eligibility: Women residents of Madhya Pradesh aged 21-60 years.
